items.text: David Montgomery (groin) off injury report after full practices, fully expected to return TNF vs IND. Woody Marks (concussion) ruled OUT; Montgomery clear lead back.
items.why: Full practices Mon-Wed, no designation; Marks OUT short week.
items.implication: Start with confidence as lead back TNF; volume secured.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone/goal-line primary; Marks absence locks role.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) ruled OUT for TNF vs IND. Nico Collins primary; Tank Dell full practice.
items.why: Official TNF injury report DNP/OUT designation.
items.implication: Collins target upgrade TNF; Harrison sit.

items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker (groin): sore last week, getting better, 'we just don't want to do something stupid.' Levitan fully agrees—playing him at less than 100% would be stupid, especially with huge Week 12 at BUF; Chiefs 15.5-pt home favorites vs ARI so no need to rush.
items.why: Reid explicit caution + DNP Wed + Levitan/Rapoport alignment; Emmett Johnson just went 28-171-2 as fill-in.
items.implication: High risk sit; monitor Fri practice closely for any upgrade.
items.opportunity: Full backfield volume to backup if OUT again; even if limited return, goal-line/third-down share at risk.

items.text: Brock Bowers (ankle) left early Week 10, day-to-day; DNP Wednesday and 'not as bad as thought but still significant' per coach. High risk of missing or limited vs DEN; Michael Mayer elevated if OUT.
items.why: Wed DNP + coach comments; multiple injury reports flag danger of missing.
items.implication: Sit if any doubt; TE1 volatility high.
items.opportunity: Mayer routes/targets spike if Bowers inactive.

items.text: Baker Mayfield DNP Wednesday with foot injury (walking boot through bye); Rapoport trending toward sitting vs DET. Jalon Daniels likely start; impacts Bucky Irving usage in run-heavy script possible.
items.why: Schefter DNP report + Rapoport 'trending sit' from NFL Live.
items.implication: Bucky Irving remains RB1 but game script may shift more run if backup QB.
items.opportunity: Irving carries/goal-line secure; possible higher snap share.

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings. Heavy workload, three-down role secure even with Brooks practicing.
items.why: Dominant recent volume (touches, red-zone, receiving); Brooks return not viewed as threat by multiple (incl Levitan dunk on Brooks hype).
items.implication: Hold/start as RB1; strong trade asset pre-deadline.
items.opportunity: 75%+ carry share, goal-line, third-down; vs BAL still RB1 floor.

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison (thumb surgery); Kevin O’Connell confirms. Will miss multiple weeks but remains on 53; Cousins return keeps MIN pass-heavy for Jefferson.
items.why: Coach confirmation no IR; surgery but short-term multi-week.
items.implication: Jefferson target share elevated short-term; Addison stash only.

items.text: Colts ruled OUT TE Will Mallory, OT Bernhard Raimann (concussion), OT Jalen Travis, DT Jerry Tillery, CB Charvarius Ward for TNF vs HOU. Sauce Gardner questionable. Impacts JT protection and passing volume.
items.why: Official Schefter report of multiple key outs on short week.
items.implication: JT still start but OL injuries raise negative game-script risk; Warren TE upside if pass-heavy.
items.opportunity: Warren routes if Mallory out; JT goal-line still primary.

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set season-high Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot—confirms pass-heavy for Justin Jefferson routes/targets. Playoff DvP also elite for MIN QBs (DET/WAS/NYJ).
items.why: PROE data spike + O'Connell scheme preference; Addison out multi weeks.
items.implication: Jefferson WR1 lock with elevated volume ROS/playoffs.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, air yards spike; two-minute/third-down.

items.text: ETR team-by-team: NE loses Drake Maye potentially for the season (ankle, possible fracture); Tommy DeVito takes over with hard negatives even if he plays. Patriots on bye Week 11.
items.why: Rapoport/Schefter aligned reports of significant ankle injury; Levitan/Silva hard negatives on NE offense without him.
items.implication: Drop/trade candidate in most formats; season likely over.
items.opportunity: NE pass-catchers (A.J. Brown hamstring too) severely downgraded ROS.

items.text: Jonathan Brooks practicing full; Levitan: 'The Jonathan Brooks slappies have a mental illness.' Not a serious threat to Chuba Hubbard lead role per ETR/Berry consensus.
items.why: Full practice but Levitan strong dissent on hype; Hubbard volume locked.
items.implication: Hubbard remains RB1; Brooks deep stash only.
items.opportunity: Hubbard carry/target share holds; Brooks change-of-pace at best.

items.text: I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
items.why: Persistent underproduction despite targets; Berry closing the book.
items.conflict: Target share still exists but efficiency/YPRR poor.

items.text: ETR ROS Top-150 half-PPR: Jonathan Taylor ahead of Chase Brown. In full-PPR Brown would be further ahead. Trade deadline context.
items.why: Updated ROS150 how they'd draft today; JT edge half-PPR volume/TD.
items.implication: Prefer JT in half-PPR trades; Brown PPR bump.
items.opportunity: Both secure lead roles; monitor Colts OL injuries (Raimann etc OUT TNF).

items.text: Mike Evans (Achilles) missed last three; Shanahan optimistic he can suit up vs MIN in Mexico City. Fri practice key; DeVonta Smith also trending return (hamstring) but with Milton at QB.
items.why: Coach optimism post-bye; Wed DNP but return window open.
items.implication: Monitor Fri; potential WR2/3 if active. Smith boost but Milton limits ceiling.
items.opportunity: Evans targets if cleared; 49ers WR room healthier.
